en: Illustrated postcard showing a grand Baroque-style building with a central clock in the pediment, tall windows with shutters, and an ornate stone staircase leading up from the foreground. An obelisk-like monument with a cross on top stands to the left of the staircase. A few figures in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand near the stairs. The reverse side contains handwritten text and printed Hungarian captions identifying the scene and publisher information.
